summary: The item and monster database that ItemInfo, DropNotifier and TabTarget read.
about: ItemDb holds the pre-renewal item and monster database: what an item does, who drops it, what a box can give, where to buy it, and every monster sheet. It downloads it once and keeps it in your browser. On its own it shows nothing: install it for ItemInfo (/ii, /mi), DropNotifier and TabTarget's rare-mob marks.

howto.text: drop a cyro.json.gz (or cyro.mobs.json.gz) on the ItemInfo window to use that database instead
the link in the ItemInfo window returns to the downloaded database
